2609.27532.title: ProCredit: From Outcome Rewards to Progress Credit in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2609.27532.paper_summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks require an agent to modify an environment through a sequence of tool calls, with success determined by the final state. The standard recipe assigns a single outcome reward at the end and compares trajectories sampled for the same task. As a result, a group with no successful trajectory yields no training signal, failed attempts cannot be told apart by how close they came to completion, and turns that advance the task receive the same credit as turns that only query the environment. Prior work refines the unit of comparison from the trajectory to the step, or trains a reward model to supply intermediate signal: the former still derives its signal from final success alone, and the latter estimates it with a model. We observe that the acceptance checks that decide success can also be run on intermediate states, so progress is as verifiable as the outcome. We propose ProCredit, which turns this verified progress into credit: it reruns the acceptance checks after each turn, rewards the turn by its change in progress, and uses these rewards to assign credit both across attempts at the same task and across the turns within a trajectory. Starting from Qwen3.5 base models at three scales on AppWorld, ProCredit outperforms outcome-reward baselines and progress-based baselines in task completion rate at every scale on both test sets, exceeding the strongest outcome-reward baseline by 4.1 percentage points at 4B, and results in a second environment show the same direction of improvement. Ablations show that adding the final progress to the trajectory score alone does not improve performance: the gain comes from crediting progress to the turn where it occurs.
2609.27532.paper_summary_zh: 長期代理任務要求代理通過一系列工具調用來修改環境，成功由最終狀態決定。標準做法在結束時分配單一的結果獎勵，並比較為同一任務抽樣的軌跡。因此，沒有成功軌跡的群體不會產生訓練信號，失敗的嘗試無法根據其接近完成的程度區分，而推進任務的回合與僅查詢環境的回合獲得相同的信用。先前的研究將比較單位從軌跡細化到步驟，或訓練獎勵模型以提供中間信號：前者仍然僅從最終成功中獲取信號，而後者則用模型來估計它。我們觀察到決定成功的接受檢查也可以在中間狀態上運行，因此進展的可驗證性與結果一樣。我們提出ProCredit，將這一驗證的進展轉化為信用：它在每次回合後重新運行接受檢查，根據進展的變化來獎勵該回合，並利用這些獎勵在同一任務的嘗試之間以及軌跡內的回合之間分配信用。從三個規模的Qwen3.5基礎模型在AppWorld上開始，ProCredit在每個測試集的任務完成率上超越了結果獎勵基準和基於進展的基準，在4B上超過最強的結果獎勵基準4.1個百分點，並且在第二個環境中的結果顯示出相同的改進方向。消融實驗顯示，僅將最終進展添加到軌跡分數並不會改善性能：增益來自於將進展歸功於發生的回合。
